title: Train a fixed-context neural language model
description: A quick reference for the fixed-context model, next-token loss, validation, and generation terms used here.

terms.definition: A fixed-context language model learning shared features instead of separate count tables.
A predetermined number of preceding token IDs used for every next-token prediction.
A learned feature vector retrieved from a shared table by token identity.
Joining context embeddings chronologically into one feature vector for processing.
A gated nonlinear transformation mapping concatenated context features into a hidden representation.
A learned mapping from hidden features to one score for each vocabulary item.
An unnormalized vocabulary score produced for one possible following token.
Average negative log-probability selected at each row's target token.
Loss measured on reserved validation examples rather than training examples.
A decoding rule repeatedly selecting the greatest permitted next-token score.
